title: Review Inbox: one queue, clear decisions
summary: Everything waiting for the DM now sits in one list, oldest first, with a clear Approve and Deny on each request.
items: Payments, loans, hires, journeys, services, treasure pool claims, training and more share one queue with type chips; empty types fold into a single "Nothing else pending" line, and an empty inbox says All caught up.
Each request shows who asked, what it does, the amount and the balance afterwards. Approve is the gold button; Deny… is outlined and can take a reason, and reasons you use are remembered.
A decided request stays in place as a short Approved or Denied note with a link to its record, so the page no longer jumps.
Approve all payments under an amount you choose, after one confirmation; each payment is still approved and charged once.
Keyboard: A approves, D denies, J and K move between requests. The Desk tab shows how many requests are waiting.
